body: Hey team, just following up on the deck from yesterday. Let me know if you need anything else from my end before Friday's review.
Hi Sarah, thanks for sending this over. I'll take a look today and get back to you by end of day tomorrow with comments.
Quick one - can we push our 2pm to 3pm? Got something come up that I can't move. Sorry for the short notice!
Morning! Coffee's on me next time you're in the office. Really appreciated you covering my shift last week.
Dear Dr. Chen, I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to request a letter of recommendation for my graduate school application, due by November 15th.
Dear Hiring Committee, Thank you for considering my application for the Software Engineering Intern position. I have attached my resume and transcript for your review.
To Whom It May Concern, I am writing to formally request an extension on the project deadline originally set for this Friday, due to unforeseen circumstances.
Dear Professor Lin, I wanted to reach out regarding the discrepancy in my midterm grade. Could we schedule a brief meeting during your office hours this week?
Hi John, I wanted to apologize for missing our call yesterday. Something came up unexpectedly and I completely lost track of time. Can we reschedule for tomorrow morning?
Hi team, sorry for the late response on this - it got buried in my inbox. I'll have the report ready by tomorrow morning, no excuses.
Hi Maria, I'm really sorry about the mixup with the invoice. I've corrected the amount and resent it - please let me know if anything still looks off.
Hey, sorry for the delay getting back to you on this. Been swamped this week but wanted to make sure I didn't leave you hanging.
Hi all, wrapping up the sprint today. We closed 14 of 16 tickets, two are carrying over to next week due to a blocked dependency on the auth service.
Hi Alex, attaching the Q3 numbers as discussed. Revenue is up 12% quarter over quarter, driven mostly by the new enterprise tier. Happy to walk through details on our call tomorrow.
Hi everyone, reminder that the office will be closed Monday for the holiday. Please make sure any time-sensitive tickets are flagged before end of day Friday.
Hi Priya, thanks for the thorough code review. I've addressed the comments around error handling and pushed an update - could you take another look when you get a chance?
Hey! Just wanted to say congrats on the launch, it looked amazing. Let's grab coffee sometime next week and catch up properly.
Hi Mr. Patel, following up on our conversation last week regarding the contract terms. Attached is the revised draft incorporating the changes we discussed.
Team, heads up that the staging environment will be down for maintenance tonight from 10pm to midnight EST. No action needed on your end.
Hi Jamie, really sorry for the confusion earlier - I sent you the wrong version of the file. The correct one is attached now.
